cohort: 4,627 mothers who gave birth in health care institutions in Bangladesh in the three years preceding the 2014 Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Several factors were statistically associated with higher rates of Cesarean section in Bangladesh, including advanced maternal age, obesity, urban residence, first birth, perception of large newborn size, husband's professional occupation, higher number of antenatal care visits, seeking antenatal care from private providers, and delivering in a private facility.
